description: Intent i023 (unclamped-wire-count, snapshot s06) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): net/bluetooth/hci_event.c:7254-7264, quote 'u8 num_reports = *ptr;' — in hci_store_wake_reason() the controller/peer-supplied HCI event skb payload is parsed with no length validation of any kind: the wire count num_reports is read one byte past the LE meta header (line 7258) and its non-zero value gates the dereference of report structs at ptr+1 (lines 7264-7279: 'adv = (void *)(ptr + 1);' then 'bacpy(&hdev->wake_addr, &adv->bdaddr); hdev->wake_addr_type = adv->bdaddr_type;'), storing OOB-read bytes into persistent struct hci_dev state. This is asymmetric validation: every sibling HCI event handler validates length first (hci_le_meta_evt enforces skb->len < subev->min_len at ~7160; hci_ev_skb_pull sites at 3031/4408/4797/4828), but this mirror wake-reason path, called at line 7534 before hci_event_func, performs none — a 1-byte LE meta event makes the *ptr fetch itself OOB, a 2-byte event with num_reports=1 makes the 9-byte struct read OOB. Impact is OOB-read only (no allocation is sized by num_reports), reachable only while suspended with wake_reason unset, attacker is a malicious/virtual controller or HCI transport peer; no runtime reproducer (read-only tree). CANDIDATES: usbip seed code present unpatched in s06 (usbip_common.c:664-665 'int np = urb->number_of_packets; int size = np * sizeof(*iso);', wire store at 473 unclamped, USBIP_MAX_ISO_PACKETS enforced only on stub_rx.c:379-381 submit direction) — excluded-by-rule per the seed-never-reportable rule, recorded unresolved; fs/ceph/snap.c:1046 safe (counts only position a pointer; ceph_decode_need/ceph_has_room bounds-check via wrap-safe pointer subtraction before any dereference, no allocation sized by the counts); net/can/bcm.c:1095 safe (RX_SETUP clamps nframes to MAX_NFRAMES+1 before kmalloc_array/kcalloc and memcpy_from_msg; update path rejects growth with -E2BIG; TX_SEND clamps at 915; bcm_send_to_user datalen derives from the clamped stored op->nframes); drivers/usb/gadget/legacy/inode.c:1119 safe (ev_next bounded by BUG_ON against N_EVENT=5; ep0 write clamped to setup_wLength before copy_from_user into setup_req-sized buffer); fs/fuse/ioctl.c:150 safe (salt_size/sig_size checked against FUSE_VERITY_ENABLE_ARG_MAX_PAGES*PAGE_SIZE). LIMITATIONS: bounded to six high-signal query families plus deep reads (ksmbd, NFC NCI, HID descriptors, dm-era/dm-zoned, qaic ioctl counts, on-disk fs superblock counts were enumerated but not deep-read); finding impact is OOB-read not heap-overflow write and mgmt userspace exposure of poisoned wake_addr was argued from code, not reproduced; line numbers from direct reads, no compilation run. Artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C9/agent-state/findings/i023.json (validated: quote occurs literally in the reported range; snapshots_checked exactly ["s06"]).
